cells.gaps: The newest count, more than 100 large municipalities in August 2025, has no total and was still to be verified; MAR-010 of May 2025 gives no count at all, and the 969 of 1,590 of May 2020 (MAR-005) is GIR-CT deployed, not local authorities recording in it, so the two figures disagree and neither is a share. MAR-008 has communes issuing bills in GIR-CT while the Treasury's accountants take the payments; no plan or finance is stated, and nothing is dated inside the twelve months (the newest events are May and August 2025).
cells.note: GIR-CT is a national register live well beyond a pilot, which is stage 3. Stage 4 needs more than half on a share or a count with a denominator, and the only figure with a denominator is a 2020 deployment figure.
